name: AURA-1
author: ahaku; based on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal
tagline: An enhanced generative ambient synthesizer for the FM-1 (built on fm1-amb)
description: AURA-1 extends fm1-amb by Charles Vestal with sixteen ambient pieces, a live polyphonic Solo synthesizer with arpeggiator and Glide, procedural textures, singing bowls and cosmic visualizations.
credits: AURA-1 is built on top of fm1-amb by Charles Vestal, fm1-base and felucca-bsp (Hügelton Instruments).
